📺 Team Moms: Baseball (2026)

Team Moms: Baseball follows seven families whose teenage sons attend Legendary Prep Academy, an elite baseball training school in Scottsdale, Arizona, where young athletes compete for opportunities to reach college baseball and potentially the major leagues. While the boys work hard to prove themselves on the field, their parents face an entirely different competition filled with intense rivalries, emotional confrontations, unexpected friendships, and family drama. As tensions rise between the families, disagreements and rumors begin testing relationships both on and off the field. Executive produced by Kim Kardashian, the reality series delivers competitive sports, unforgettable personalities, and dramatic moments while exploring parental ambition, family loyalty, sacrifice, and the pressure of raising the next generation of baseball stars.

🎭 Genre: Reality TV • Sports • Drama

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 44–50 minutes per episode • TV-14

📺 Episodes: 8 • Season 1

🎥 Executive Producer: Kim Kardashian

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ in the United States.
